site.title: AI Management
site.tagline: Where AI meets strategy, organization, and value creation.
site.tagline_zh: AI 與策略、組織與價值創造的交會之處。
site.description: Business, management, and consulting articles on the impact of AI in business.

sections.name: Case Studies
sections.description: Multi-perspective investigations of a single business problem, shown through the editorial lens of five major publications.
sections.description_zh: 以五大出版機構的編輯視角，透視單一商業難題的多角度案例研究。

items.title: VIBEITDA: Why AI-Native Companies Can Grow Without Growing Headcount
items.title_zh: VIBEITDA：為何 AI 原生公司能在不增加人手下成長
items.summary: When AI lets companies increase output faster than payroll, the old trade-off between venture-style growth and private-equity-style efficiency collapses. Five publications examine the consequences from five angles.
items.summary_zh: 當 AI 讓企業的產出增長快於薪酬增長，傳統「增長 vs 效率」的二選一便告失效。五種出版角度解析這場變革。
cover_zh_text: 為何 AI 原生公司能在不增加人手下成長

items.title: Scrum in the Age of AI Agents: When Execution Becomes Abundant
items.title_zh: AI 代理時代的 Scrum：當執行變得充裕
items.summary: AI agents are making software execution abundant, and the bottleneck moves from producing change to verifying it. Five publications examine what that shift does to Scrum, to engineering productivity, and to the economics of software delivery.
items.summary_zh: AI 代理令軟件執行變得充裕，瓶頸也由「生產變更」轉移到「驗證變更」。五種出版角度剖析這場轉變對 Scrum、工程生產力與軟件交付經濟學的衝擊。

items.title: When Code Becomes Abundant: Rethinking Engineering Performance in the Age of AI
items.title_zh: 當代碼變得充裕：重新思考 AI 時代的工程績效
items.summary: AI coding tools are making engineering activity cheap to produce, hollowing out the signals managers have always used to judge performance. Five publications examine how engineering performance management must move upstream — from counting output to measuring judgment, uncertainty reduction, and difficulty retired.
items.summary_zh: AI 編程工具令工程活動變得廉價，掏空了管理者賴以判斷績效的訊號。五種出版角度剖析工程績效管理如何向上游轉移——由點算產出，轉向量度判斷力、降低不確定性與難度退役。

sections.name: Articles
sections.description: Management articles on AI strategy, organization design, and value creation.
sections.description_zh: 有關 AI 策略、組織設計與價值創造的管理文章。

items.title: The AI-Native Software Dark Factory: From Goldratt to Generative Software Systems
items.title_zh: AI 原生軟件暗廠：從高德拉特到生成式軟件系統
items.summary: A software dark factory is not Ford's assembly line. It is a compiler-like program-synthesis and template-generation system built on reusable product-line assets, independent verification, and Goldratt-inspired economic discipline.
items.summary_zh: 軟件暗廠並非福特式裝配線，而是結合程式合成、低代碼範本生成、可重用軟件產品線資產、獨立驗證及限制理論經濟思維的 AI 原生系統。

items.title: Sell the Work, Not the Doorway: How SaaS Wins in the Age of Agents
items.title_zh: 賣的是工作，不是門口：SaaS 如何在代理時代勝出
items.summary: Forcing customers onto a proprietary agent to mark up model usage is an access toll, not a moat. Why controlled openness — open the capability layer, govern the transactions, charge for trusted execution — is the more durable SaaS strategy.
items.summary_zh: 強迫客戶使用專有代理來加價轉售模型用量，是通行費而非護城河。為何「受控開放」——開放能力層、掌控交易、對可信執行收費——才是更持久的 SaaS 策略。

items.title: AI Junior-Engineer Agents and the Rewiring of Software Organizations
items.title_zh: AI 初級工程師代理與軟件組織的重新佈線
items.summary: Give every engineer an agent as capable as a junior engineer and the org chart does not just speed up: the firm shifts toward human judgment, boundary ownership, and review. Research evidence and a game-theoretic look at same-team, cross-team, and vendor-negotiation scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 給每位工程師配一個相當於初級工程師的代理，組織不會只是變快，而是轉向人類判斷、邊界擁有權與審查。結合研究證據，並以博弈論分析同一團隊、跨團隊與供應商談判三種情境。

items.title: Beyond Lines of Code: Rethinking Developer Performance in the AI Era
items.title_zh: 超越代碼行數：重新思考 AI 時代的開發者績效
items.summary: AI has made code cheap, so volume metrics no longer measure performance. A difficulty-adjusted model, the traces that separate the lazy from the unlucky, and a low-effort, defensible improvement workflow for engineering managers.
items.summary_zh: AI 令代碼變得廉價，數量指標不再能衡量績效。經難度調整的模型、分辨「懶」與「運氣差」的痕跡，以及給工程經理的低工夫、站得住腳的改善流程。

items.title: Office Politics in the Age of AI
items.title_zh: AI 時代的辦公室政治
items.summary: When AI works only if knowledge is written down, indexed, and permissioned, influence shifts from holders of tribal knowledge to those who control the knowledge supply chain. A map of the new power levers, tactics, risks, and a roadmap for organizations.
items.summary_zh: 當 AI 必須依靠被寫下、索引並設定權限的知識才能運作，影響力便由部落知識的持有者，轉移到掌控知識供應鏈的人。新權力槓桿、手段、風險與組織路線圖一覽。

items.title: Why I Hate Micromanaging People but Love Micromanaging AI
items.title_zh: 為何我討厭事事插手管人，卻樂於事事插手管 AI
items.summary: An engineering manager explains the paradox of managing human engineers and AI agents — and why the real dividing line is ownership and motivation, not intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 一位工程經理剖析管理人類工程師與 AI 代理的矛盾——以及為何真正的分水嶺是承擔與動機，而非智能。
